subject: POC kickoff — hands-on prompt review & routing load test
messages:
From: Emilia Soto <emilia@blueleaf.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finex.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 13:09:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff: hands-on prompt review + routing load test

Hi Rishi —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Blueleaf is excited to run a short POC that focuses on: prompt conformance (structured outputs), routing policy for message types, and a small load test to validate tokens/sec for peak paths.

High-level asks from our side:
- Hands-on workshop to review prompts and expected structured outputs (json schema examples)
- Run a 30–60 minute controlled load test hitting the routing path for critical flows (~5k tokens/second peak, bursty)
- A short mutual action plan and owner list so we can tie this into procurement afterwards

Proposed kickoff week: May 24–28 (we're US-PST). Key participants: me (Product), Alex (SRE), and our security contact — we'll share the prompt inventory ahead of time.

Can you confirm availability and whether you need anything from us beforehand (files, expected SLOs, guardrails)?

Thanks,
Emilia Soto
Head of Product, Blueleaf Analytics
[Attachment: example-prompt-sample.json (application/json)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Emilia Soto <emilia@blueleaf.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finex.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff: hands-on prompt review + routing load test

Emilia —

Appreciate the clear scope. We can absolutely run the hands-on prompt review plus a controlled routing-focused load test. Quick notes and asks from our side so the kickoff is high bandwidth: 

Pre-kickoff deliverables (please attach or share Drive links):
- Prompt inventory (spreadsheet: prompt text, expected structured output, sample inputs)
- A representative schema or sample JSON for the structured outputs you expect
- Traffic profile: average tokens/sec and peak burst (example format attached)
- Any hard guardrails (blacklisted tokens, PII redaction rules)

What we will provide before the session:
- POC runbook (attached: POC-runbook-v1.pdf) with agenda, roles, and load-test steps
- Prompt-inventory-template.xlsx to align formatting
- Proposed time windows for the live session and load test (see options below)

Proposed session slots (all PT):
1) Tue May 25 — 10:00–12:00 (2h hands-on, followed by 30m buffer for load test prep)
2) Wed May 26 — 13:00–15:00 (same format)
3) Thu May 27 — 08:00–10:00 (early slot; good for cross-region attendees)

Load test window: we recommend a 30-minute controlled run immediately following the hands-on segment; we will need an engineer from your side to monitor traffic shaping.

Can you confirm which slot works and share the prompt inventory by EOD Tue 18 May so our infra team can stage the Dedicated pool?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: POC-runbook-v1.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Blueleaf POC — resource and infra coordination

Ben / Marissa —

Blueleaf wants a hands-on prompt review + routing load test the week of May 24–27. They asked for a 30–60 minute controlled load test after the workshop. Please see the minimal checklist and ask for a quick confirm: 

Checklist
- Infra: can we provision a Dedicated pool with the quantized model and 4x A100-equivalent GPU backend for a 30-minute run? (Target: 5k tokens/s peak, with autoscale headroom)
- SDK/Engineer on call: need someone to run the load harness and watch KV cache behavior (ideally the engineer who wrote the batching code)
- Telemetry: enable per-route token-level logs + tracing for the window; retention for 7 days minimum
- AV/Recording: send calendar invite with recording enabled (customer asks for recording)

Constraints / risks
- If Dedicated pool can't be guaranteed we will fallback to staged hosted nodes which may have tighter throttling — call this out in pre-kickoff notes
- We need prompt inventory from Blueleaf by Tue EOD May 18 to validate structured-output alignment

Ben — can you confirm infra availability and whether you need a specific SRE? Marissa — can you draft the invite and copy the runbook into the Drive folder when ready?

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Blueleaf POC — resource and infra coordination

Rishi —

We can provision a Dedicated pool for that window. Confirmed resources:
- Infra SRE: Alex Nguyen (on-call) will handle the Dedicated pool + autoscale policy
- Load harness: I can run the load harness with SDK v2.1 and monitor tokens/sec
- Telemetry: Marissa, please enable per-route logs and set trace-level to debug for the 1 hour around the test

Recommended final slot: May 25, 10:00–12:30 PT (2h workshop + 30m load test buffer). I attached a draft calendar slot (availability.ics).

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: availability.ics]

Emilia —

Thanks — confirmed. We'll run the hands-on prompt review on Tue May 25, 10:00–12:30 PT (2h workshop + 30m controlled load test). Action items and links below: 

Action items for Blueleaf (before EOD Tue May 18):
- Share prompt inventory using the attached template: prompt-inventory-template.xlsx
- Provide expected structured-output JSON schema samples
- Confirm an SRE point-of-contact to observe the load test

Best,
